papers.title: CityPlanner: A Sandbox Agent for Executable Urban Planning
papers.title_zh: CityPlanner：面向可执行城市规划的沙盒智能体
papers.reason: 该论文提出CityPlanner沙盒智能体框架用于可执行城市规划，直接涉及城市更新与规划、LLM智能体和多智能体系统，与GIS博士研究中的城市更新、LLM和多智能体方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: Urban planning is a real-world spatial optimization problem that requires selecting feasible actions from large candidate spaces under practical objectives such as cost and service quality. Existing optimization and reinforcement learning methods are effective for fixed formulations, but often depend on task-specific representations and constraint handling. We propose \emph{CityPlanner}, a sandbox-agent framework for executable urban planning. CityPlanner introduces \emph{UrbanSandbox}, a unified file-based environment where agents inspect task files, generate plans, run evaluators, and revise decisions based on executable feedback. To make learning tractable, we further propose atomic-task reinforcement learning, which decomposes long sandbox trajectories into \emph{BuildPlan} for initial construction and \emph{ImprovePlan} for feedback-based refinement. Experiments on a real-world benchmark show that CityPlanner consistently outperforms heuristic, task-specific RL, and general LLM-agent baselines. Ablations verify the contributions of UrbanSandbox, atomic-task RL, and iterative deployment. We release the code and dataset at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/co-agent-C1C8
papers.summary_zh: 城市规划是一个现实世界的空间优化问题，需要在成本和服务质量等实际目标下从大量候选空间中选择可行行动。现有优化和强化学习方法对固定公式有效，但通常依赖任务特定的表示和约束处理。我们提出CityPlanner，一个用于可执行城市规划的沙盒智能体框架。CityPlanner引入UrbanSandbox，一个统一的基于文件的环境，智能体在其中检查任务文件、生成规划、运行评估器，并根据可执行反馈修正决策。为使学习可行，我们进一步提出原子任务强化学习，将长沙盒轨迹分解为用于初始建设的BuildPlan和用于基于反馈细化的ImprovePlan。在真实世界基准上的实验表明，CityPlanner持续优于启发式、任务特定RL和通用LLM智能体基线。消融实验验证了UrbanSandbox、原子任务RL和迭代部署的贡献。代码和数据集发布于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/co-agent-C1C8。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作将LLM智能体与强化学习结合用于城市规划的沙盒环境，其原子任务分解和可执行反馈机制为城市更新中的空间决策优化提供了新思路，与GIS博士研究中LLM和多智能体方向直接相关。

papers.title: From Pixels to Hierarchical Sequences: Quadtree Mask Encoding for Vision-Language Binary Change Detection
papers.title_zh: 从像素到层次序列：面向视觉语言二值变化检测的四叉树掩码编码
papers.reason: 该论文直接针对遥感二值变化检测，提出基于四叉树掩码编码的视觉语言模型框架，与遥感变化检测和地理空间智能高度相关，且涉及多模态大模型在遥感中的应用。
papers.abstract: Dense change detection in remote sensing requires vision-language models (VLMs) to compare bi-temporal images and generate accurate pixel-level masks. Existing VLMs are largely confined to change captioning outputs, and the few that produce pixel-level masks still rely on external decoders or flat text-as-mask serialization, which are less effective for small and fragmented changes. We introduce QUAKE-CD, a framework that recasts dense change prediction as syntax-verifiable structured generation. QUAKE-CD represents binary change masks as grammar-constrained quadtree token sequences, making the masks compact, syntactically checkable, and deterministically decodable within an autoregressive generation space. We further construct QUAKE-CoT, which pairs these sequences with chain-of-thought traces grounded in visual evidence, and jointly optimizes textual reasoning and spatial dense prediction through a progressive curriculum followed by grammar-gated dual-reward RL. On QUAKE-CoT, QUAKE-CD achieves 78.31% accumulated F1, outperforming decoder-based and flat text-as-mask VLMs while producing more faithful bi-temporal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh: 遥感中的密集变化检测要求视觉语言模型（VLM）比较双时相图像并生成准确的像素级掩码。现有VLM大多局限于变化描述输出，少数能生成像素级掩码的仍依赖外部解码器或扁平文本即掩码序列化，对细小和碎片化变化效果较差。我们提出QUAKE-CD，一个将密集变化预测重构为语法可验证结构化生成的框架。QUAKE-CD将二值变化掩码表示为语法约束的四叉树令牌序列，使掩码紧凑、语法可检查，并可在自回归生成空间内确定性解码。我们进一步构建QUAKE-CoT，将这些序列与基于视觉证据的思维链轨迹配对，并通过渐进式课程和语法门控双奖励强化学习联合优化文本推理与空间密集预测。在QUAKE-CoT上，QUAKE-CD达到78.31%累积F1，优于基于解码器和扁平文本即掩码的VLM，同时产生更忠实的双时相推理。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作将变化检测掩码编码为四叉树序列并利用VLM进行结构化生成，为遥感变化检测提供了新范式，其语法约束和思维链推理机制可能提升对碎片化城市变化的检测能力，但论文未明确涉及城市更新场景。

papers.title: Hyperbolic Geometry for Open-World Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.title_zh: 双曲几何用于遥感影像开放世界目标检测
papers.reason: 该论文针对遥感影像中的开放世界目标检测，利用双曲几何建模类别层次关系，与遥感图像分析和地理空间智能相关，但未直接涉及变化检测或城市更新。
papers.abstract: Open-world object detection (OWOD) extends closed-set detection by requiring models to identify unknown objects and incrementally learn them once annotations become available. In remote sensing imagery, object categories often exhibit latent hierarchical relationships that may be inadequately represented in the Euclidean spaces commonly adopted by existing methods, limiting unknown-object recall and incremental-learning performance. To address this issue, we investigate hyperbolic geometry for OWOD in remote sensing imagery and propose HyRS-OWOD. To improve unknown object recall, we design a two-step unknown-object discovery mechanism: a Decoupled Objectness Learning (DOL) module that disentangles foreground perception from semantic information to separate foreground proposals from background regions, followed by a Hyperbolic Uncertainty Learning (HUL) component that leverages the radius of hyperbolic embeddings as an uncertainty-aware cue for known-unknown discrimination. For incremental learning, we develop a Hyperbolic Metric Learning (HML) strategy that enhances inter-class separability, facilitating the incorporation of novel categories while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Experiments on three remote sensing benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in unknown recall and incremental learning over state-of-the-art OWOD methods.
papers.summary_zh: 开放世界目标检测（OWOD）扩展了闭集检测，要求模型识别未知物体并在标注可用后增量学习它们。在遥感影像中，物体类别通常表现出潜在的层次关系，而现有方法常用的欧几里得空间可能无法充分表示这些关系，限制了未知物体召回和增量学习性能。为解决这一问题，我们研究了双曲几何在遥感影像OWOD中的应用，并提出HyRS-OWOD。为提高未知物体召回，我们设计了两步未知物体发现机制：解耦物体性学习（DOL）模块将前景感知与语义信息解耦，以分离前景提议与背景区域；随后双曲不确定性学习（HUL）组件利用双曲嵌入的半径作为不确定性感知线索进行已知-未知判别。对于增量学习，我们开发了双曲度量学习（HML）策略，增强类间可分性，促进新类别的纳入同时减轻灾难性遗忘。在三个遥感基准上的实验表明，与最先进的OWOD方法相比，在未知召回和增量学习方面均有一致改进。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作将双曲几何引入遥感开放世界检测以建模类别层次结构，其不确定性感知和增量学习策略对处理城市更新中不断出现的新地物类别具有潜在启发，但论文未涉及城市更新或变化检测任务。

papers.title: Spatio-temporal dual-stage hypergraph MARL for human-centric multimodal corridor traffic signal control
papers.title_zh: 基于时空双阶段超图多智能体强化学习的多模态走廊交通信号控制
papers.reason: 该研究提出基于超图的多智能体强化学习框架用于交通信号控制，其时空依赖建模和集中训练分散执行范式与城市更新和时空数据挖掘方向相关。
papers.abstract: Human-centric traffic signal control in corridor networks must increasingly account for multimodal travelers, particularly high-occupancy public transportation, rather than focusing solely on vehicle-centric performance. This paper proposes STDSH-MARL (Spatio-Temporal Dual-Stage Hypergraph based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning), a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework that follows a centralized training and decentralized execution paradigm. The proposed method captures spatio-temporal dependencies through a novel dual-stage hypergraph attention mechanism that models interactions across both spatial and temporal hyperedges. In addition, a hybrid discrete action space is introduced to jointly determine the next signal phase configuration and its corresponding green duration, enabling more adaptive signal timing decisions. Experiments conducted on a corridor network under five traffic scenarios demonstrate that STDSH-MARL achieves strong overall multimodal performance, with substantial and relatively consistent reductions in tram waiting time, while improvements in bus waiting time are more variable across traffic scenarios. These results highlight the trade-off among overall network efficiency, tram priority, and bus service quality. Compared with state-of-the-art baseline methods, the proposed approach achieves superior overall performance. Further ablation studies confirm the contribution of each component of STDSH-MARL, with temporal hyperedges identified as the most influential factor driving the observed performance gains.
papers.summary_zh: 提出STDSH-MARL，一种基于时空双阶段超图注意力机制的多智能体深度强化学习框架，用于多模态走廊交通信号控制。通过混合离散动作空间联合决定信号相位和绿灯时长。在走廊网络的五种交通场景下，该方法在整体性能上优于基线，并显著减少了有轨电车等待时间，消融实验表明时间超边贡献最大。
papers.insight_zh: 通过超图结构同时建模空间和时间维度的复杂交互，并采用混合动作空间，可以更有效地协调多智能体在交通信号控制中的决策，实现多模态交通流的优化。

papers.title: Physics-constrained cross-resolution enhancement network for optics-guided thermal UAV image super-resolution
papers.title_zh: 物理约束的跨分辨率增强网络用于光学引导的热红外无人机图像超分辨率
papers.venue: ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
papers.reason: 研究光学引导的热红外无人机图像超分辨率，涉及物理约束和多源融合，与遥感图像处理和城市监测相关，但主要面向热红外数据。
papers.summary_zh: 提出一种物理约束的跨分辨率增强网络，利用光学图像引导热红外无人机图像的超分辨率重建。
papers.insight_zh: 物理约束可能提升超分辨率质量，但未提及具体实验，需评估其在不同场景下的表现。

papers.title: ScopeMamba-YOLO: Widening the Perceptual Scope Inward and Outward for Small Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.title_zh: ScopeMamba-YOLO：面向遥感影像小目标检测的内外感知范围扩展
papers.reason: 该论文针对遥感影像中的小目标检测提出ScopeMamba-YOLO框架，属于遥感图像分析与深度学习目标检测，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合中的遥感影像处理有较强关联，但未涉及城市更新或时空数据挖掘。
papers.abstract: Small object detection in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and remote sensing imagery requires preserving high-resolution detail while modeling long-range context. Adding a stride-4 detection level and removing the stride-32 stage benefits tiny targets but weakens peripheral spatial support, whereas directly inserting selective scanning into the main feature path can interfere with weak local cues. We propose ScopeMamba-YOLO, built around an off-path, zero-gated selective-scanning principle that decouples contextual modeling from the convolutional stream. The principle is instantiated by a Cascaded Global-Context Module (CGCM) in the backbone and a Selective-Scan PAN (SS-PAN) in the neck. An Adaptive Multi-scale Strip (AMS) Block reduces the cost of high-resolution feature extraction, while a Scale-Adaptive DFL (SA-DFL) head reallocates distributional support and regression capacity across scales with only 0.008M additional parameters. Controlled experiments show that matched main-path selective scanning reduces mAP50 by 0.98 pp, whereas off-path CGCM improves the final configuration by 0.67 pp over the three-seed no-CGCM mean; operator controls indicate that this gain is not explained by auxiliary branch capacity alone. ERF analysis further shows that the complete context pathway increases the peripheral energy ratio from 0.008 to 0.090 at stride 8. On VisDrone-2019, ScopeMamba-S achieves 50.8% mAP50 with 3.57M parameters, exceeding YOLOv8s by 10.8 pp while using 32% of its parameters; ScopeMamba-M reaches 52.6% mAP50 with 6.48M parameters. Consistent improvements are also observed on AI-TOD, especially for very-tiny and tiny objects.
papers.summary_zh: 无人机和遥感影像中的小目标检测需要在保留高分辨率细节的同时建模长程上下文。增加步长为4的检测层并移除步长为32的阶段有利于微小目标，但削弱了外围空间支持；而直接将选择性扫描插入主特征路径可能干扰微弱的局部线索。我们提出ScopeMamba-YOLO，围绕一种离路径、零门控的选择性扫描原则构建，将上下文建模与卷积流解耦。该原则通过骨干网络中的级联全局上下文模块（CGCM）和颈部中的选择性扫描PAN（SS-PAN）实现。自适应多尺度条带（AMS）块降低了高分辨率特征提取的成本，而尺度自适应DFL（SA-DFL）头仅增加0.008M参数即可重新分配跨尺度的分布支持和回归能力。对照实验表明，匹配的主路径选择性扫描使mAP50降低0.98个百分点，而离路径CGCM相比三个种子无CGCM均值使最终配置提升0.67个百分点；算子控制表明该增益不能仅由辅助分支容量解释。ERF分析进一步显示，完整上下文路径在步长8处将外围能量比从0.008提升至0.090。在VisDrone-2019上，ScopeMamba-S以3.57M参数达到50.8% mAP50，超过YOLOv8s 10.8个百分点，仅使用其32%的参数；ScopeMamba-M以6.48M参数达到52.6% mAP50。在AI-TOD上也观察到一致改进，尤其是对极微小和微小目标。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提出的离路径选择性扫描机制和尺度自适应检测头为遥感小目标检测提供了新思路，其在高分辨率特征提取与长程上下文建模之间的平衡策略可迁移至遥感变化检测中的细小变化区域识别，但论文本身未涉及变化检测任务。

papers.title: Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.title_zh: Marigold V2：重新审视用于单目深度估计的扩散Transformer
papers.reason: 该研究提出Marigold V2，利用扩散Transformer（DiT）架构进行单目深度估计，并展示了其在表面法线估计等密集回归任务上的应用，与遥感中的三维重建和地形分析等技术有较强的关联性。
papers.abstract: Monocular depth estimation is a ubiquitous yet highly ill-posed computer vision task, with downstream applications in scene reconstruction, computational photography, and robotics, among others. Despite the field's maturity, recent models still struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution inputs and to produce sharp and detailed depth maps. In this paper, we revisit Marigold, a set of techniques for repurposing modern image generation and editing models, powered by the diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture, into state-of-the-art monocular depth estimators. Our recipes target single-step inference from pretrained multi-step flow-matching models, with quantization where needed, preserving model capacity while remaining cheap to run. We analyze the artifacts of naive training and identify two effective remedies: aligning the model's internal representations with semantic features extracted from ground-truth, and adopting a 2-stage fine-tuning protocol built around a novel Sinkhorn-based loss. The results are crisper, cleaner depth maps that generalize well out-of-distribution, with 16-26% improvement in AbsRel over the previous best on KITTI and ETH3D. Qualitatively, our model resolves fur, foliage, and hair-thin edges that have eluded prior models. Furthermore, Marigold V2 achieves state-of-the-art results when applied to other dense regression tasks, such as surface normals estimation and intrinsic image decomposition. Project website: https://hf.co/spaces/huawei-bayerlab/marigold-v2-web
papers.summary_zh: Marigold V2重新审视了利用扩散Transformer（DiT）架构进行单目深度估计的技术。其方法针对从预训练的多步流匹配模型中进行单步推理，并采用量化技术。通过将模型内部表示与语义特征对齐，并采用基于Sinkhorn损失的两阶段微调协议，模型在KITTI和ETH3D上的AbsRel比之前最优结果提升了16-26%，能生成更清晰、更干净的深度图，并泛化到分布外数据。该方法也适用于表面法线估计等任务。
papers.insight_zh: 扩散Transformer架构通过适当的微调策略，不仅能生成高质量图像，也能在单目深度估计等密集预测任务上达到最先进水平，表明生成式预训练模型具有强大的几何理解潜力。

papers.title: Weakly-supervised Kidney Tumor Classification from CT Scans with Multi-Instance Learning and Anatomical Filtering
papers.title_zh: 基于多实例学习与解剖过滤的CT扫描肾脏肿瘤弱监督分类
papers.reason: 该研究针对CT扫描分析中像素级标注稀缺的问题，提出了结合多实例学习和解剖过滤的弱监督分类方法。这与研究者在遥感领域处理大规模影像、利用有限标注以及提升模型泛化能力方面的兴趣高度相关，其方法框架对地理空间智能中的弱监督学习具有借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: Deep learning models for CT scan analysis are often limited by the scarcity of precise pixel-level annotations, which require significant radiologist effort to produce. Training on scan-level labels alone reduces annotation requirements but introduces challenges: low supervision ratios and large input volumes make models prone to overfitting and shortcut learning. In this work, we investigate two complementary methods to address these challenges: multi-instance learning (MIL) and anatomical filtering. MIL divides CT volumes into 2D slice instances, enabling efficient 2D architectures with ImageNet pretraining rather than computationally demanding 3D models. Anatomical filtering uses Compass, our self-supervised body part regression model, to crop scans to pathology-relevant subregions without requiring segmentation masks. We evaluate two MIL frameworks - Attention-based MIL (ABMIL) and FocusMIL - on kidney tumor classification across one internal dataset (TUH) and two external datasets (KiTS23 and TCGA-KiRC). Our best models achieve F1 = 0.83 on the internal test set using only scan-level labels. We further show that anatomical filtering with the Compass model is critical for the out-of-distribution generalization of embedding-based ABMIL, while instance-based FocusMIL demonstrates greater inherent robustness to distribution shift. While evaluated on kidney tumors, we consider this a proof-of-concept for a broader weakly supervised CT classification pipeline applicable to other organs and pathologies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将CT体积划分为2D切片实例，采用基于注意力的MIL (ABMIL) 和FocusMIL框架进行分类，并使用自监督身体部位回归模型Compass进行解剖过滤，以裁剪出病理相关的子区域。在内部和外部数据集上的实验表明，仅使用扫描级标签即可达到F1=0.83，且解剖过滤对基于嵌入的ABMIL的分布外泛化至关重要。
papers.insight_zh: 对于弱监督的医学影像分类，结合解剖先验进行区域过滤能有效提升基于嵌入的模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，而实例级方法则表现出更强的内在鲁棒性。

papers.title: TD-STGT: A Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer for Mobile Traffic Demand Forecasting
papers.title_zh: TD-STGT：用于移动流量需求预测的时空图Transformer
papers.reason: 该研究预测细粒度移动流量需求，属于城市时空数据挖掘范畴，与城市更新中的基础设施规划相关。
papers.abstract: Fine-grained mobile traffic demand forecasting is essential for long-term planning of 5G and future 6G networks, including radio upgrades, site densification, backhaul expansion, and spectrum activation. This paper proposes the Traffic Demand Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer (TD-STGT), a graph neural forecasting framework for predicting changes in wireless mobile traffic demand across fine geographic grids. The framework uses a population-scaled demand proxy developed from crowdsourced mobile measurements and daytime population information. Experiments across five Canadian metropolitan regions show that TD-STGT achieves the best performance in forecasting grid-level demand changes, reaching a $ΔR^2$ of 0.462 and reducing $Δ$RMSE by 5.7\% relative to the strongest baseline. The proposed model provides a practical tool for identifying areas with increasing demand pressure and prioritizing future mobile-network capacity upgrades.
papers.summary_zh: 提出TD-STGT，一种图神经预测框架，用于预测细粒度地理网格上的无线移动流量需求变化。框架使用基于众包移动测量和日间人口信息开发的人口规模需求代理。在加拿大五个都市区的实验中，TD-STGT在预测网格级需求变化方面表现最佳，ΔR²达到0.462，ΔRMSE相对最强基线降低5.7%。
papers.insight_zh: 结合人口分布代理和时空图Transformer，可有效预测网格级移动流量需求变化，为网络容量规划提供决策支持。

papers.title: DCFA: Dual-view Causal-inspired Attribution for Failure Reasoning in LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
papers.title_zh: DCFA：基于双视角因果启发的LLM多智能体系统故障推理归因
papers.reason: 论文聚焦于LLM多智能体系统的故障归因，与用户研究中LLM和多智能体方向高度相关。其提出的因果启发式依赖图构建与反事实推理方法，对理解复杂系统中的时空交互与决策链有借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have experienced rapid growth in recent years. Despite their promise, such systems remain fragile, frequently exhibiting reasoning and coordination errors that can lead to system-level failures. Failure attribution in such systems relies on tracing natural language interactions among agents to identify the decisive error, which refers to the earliest action whose correction can reverse system failure. There are two key challenges: 1) Shallow attribution: Existing methods often capture only minor deviations, such as incomplete retrievals or formatting errors, which verification mechanisms can correct, while missing the decisive cause of system failure. 2) Contextual degradation: As the length of the system traces increases, the model's reasoning ability rapidly deteriorates. To address these challenges, we propose DCFA, a training-free framework for failure attribution. DCFA integrates a global module that constructs structured causal-inspired dependency graphs from system traces to identify the initial decisive error, and a local module that applies local counterfactual-inspired reasoning to refine causal-inspired attribution. Experiments on the Who&When benchmark across six LLMs show that DCFA improves step-level accuracy by up to 8.27% over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh: 提出DCFA框架，用于LLM多智能体系统的故障归因。该框架包含一个全局模块，从系统轨迹中构建结构化的因果启发式依赖图以识别初始决定性错误；以及一个局部模块，应用局部反事实推理来细化归因。在Who&When基准上，DCFA将步骤级准确率提升了高达8.27%。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究展示了如何将因果推断思想应用于复杂系统轨迹分析，其全局-局部归因框架或可迁移至时空数据挖掘中，用于识别城市更新等复杂过程中的关键驱动因素。
